SELECT DISTINCT PRD_LAYER_PARAM.PROD_STYLE id, PRD_LAYER_PARAM.PROD_STYLE text, PRD_LAYER_PARAM.FINPROD_ID object FROM PRD_LAYER_PARAM WHERE P_FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND PRD_LAYER_PARAM.PROD_STYLE LIKE concat('%',concat(#{search},'%'))
select FIN_PRODUCT.VDATE, FIN_PRODUCT.MDATE from FIN_PRODUCT where FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_ID cashId, FIN_CASH_INFO.FEE_ID feeId, MST_FEEINFO.FEE_TYPE feeType, FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE.BASIS basis, FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE.BASE_TYPE basicBill, FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE.FIRST_BASE_TYPE firstBaseType, FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.END_TDAY_RULE calcFeeTradeRule, FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.PAY_TDAY_RULE payFeeTradeRule, FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.PAY_CYCLE payFeeRule, FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.EFF_DATE effDate, FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE.F_ACCR_DATE provisionFirstDay, FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE.ACCR_TDAY_RULE accrTdayRule, FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE.YIELD * 100 feeRate, FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE.BASE_DATE_TYPE netAssetValueDay, FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE.E_ACCR_DATE eAccrDate, FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.FIRST_PAY_DATE firstCalEndDate, MST_FEEINFO.CHARGE_TYPE chargeType, prd_layer_param.FINPROD_ID prodStyle, FIN_PRODUCT.VDATE vdate, FIN_PRODUCT.MDATE mdate, FIN_PRODUCT.LIQUIDATION_DATE liquidationDate, FIN_PRODUCT.CALENDAR_ID dealCalId, FIN_PRODUCT.PROFIT_TYPE profitType from FIN_CASH_INFO, MST_FEEINFO, FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE, FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE, FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE, FIN_PRODUCT left join prd_layer_param on FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = prd_layer_param.FINPROD_ID WHERE FIN_CASH_INFO.FEE_ID = MST_FEEINFO.FEE_ID and FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID and FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_ID = FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE.CASH_ID
and FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_ID = FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.CASH_ID
and FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_ID = FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE.CASH_ID
and (FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} or prd_layer_param.P_FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}) and FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{cashType1} and MST_FEEINFO.FEE_TYPE in (#{feeTypeTrust}, #{feeTypeFix}, #{feeTypeSale}, #{feeTypeOthSale}, #{feeTypeThService},#{feeTypeInvest}) and FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType} and FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.EFF_DATE = FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE.EFF_DATE and FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.EFF_DATE = FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE.EFF_DATE and FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.EFF_DATE = (select max(cpr.eff_date) from FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE cpr where cpr.cash_id = FIN_CASH_INFO.cash_id)
select b.* from FIN_PRODUCT a inner join FIN_PRODUCT b on a.FINPROD_ID = b.P_FINPROD_ID where a.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}
